tables.name: logs_ip_actions
tables.comment: Used to log ips of individual actions

columns.name: comment
columns.comment: Allows users to add a comment

tables.name: rbac_default_permissions
tables.comment: Default permission to assign to different account security levels

tables.name: updates
tables.comment: List of all applied updates in this database.

columns.name: name
columns.comment: filename with extension of the update.

columns.name: hash
columns.comment: sha1 hash of the sql file.

columns.name: state
columns.comment: defines if an update is released or archived.

columns.name: timestamp
columns.comment: timestamp when the query was applied.

columns.name: speed
columns.comment: time the query takes to apply in ms.

tables.name: updates_include
tables.comment: List of directories where we want to include sql updates.

columns.name: path
columns.comment: directory to include. $ means relative to the source directory.

columns.name: state
columns.comment: defines if the directory contains released or archived updates.
